cases.name: equivalent_formula
cases.description: Rewrites full capital growth recurrence using SUM identity; original engine computes all outputs.

cases.name: equivalent_static_initialization
cases.description: Only immutable observed 2019 initialization is static; all restored future series remain dynamic.

cases.name: wrong_timing
cases.description: One capital recurrence uses current investment instead of prior-year investment.

cases.name: wrong_transition_year
cases.description: One editable input reaches target a year early.

cases.name: constant_offset
cases.description: Scenario per-capita GDP report has constant 1000 level offset in every year; correct response differences must retain R004.

cases.name: mixed_final
cases.description: Correct native final per-capita GDP conflicts with one final report cell; all stated representations checked.

cases.name: duplicate_omission
cases.description: Report repeats 2034 while omitting 2035; multiset assertions detect both.

cases.name: legal_formula_limit
cases.description: Legal identity LAMBDA unsupported by selected recalculation adapter is pending adjudication, never zero.

cases.name: required_engine_error
cases.description: Required bound recalc error is separated from a scored business failure; unrelated existing memo #REF is ignored.

cases.name: equivalent_layout
cases.description: Whole comparison table moves four rows/two columns; self-formulas and chart references move, source references preserve meaning.

cases.name: swapped_chart_labels
cases.description: Chart baseline/scenario names swapped without changing series data.

cases.name: malformed
cases.description: Completed run produced a corrupt workbook.

cases.name: partial_parse
cases.description: A material year-indexed numeric result table uses unbound case labels while native source sheets still parse; no partial total.

cases.name: unfilled_template
cases.description: Submitted incomplete source template has no unbound result table; missing requested facts are scored business omissions.

cases.name: source_rows_reordered
cases.description: Same complete source records reordered; native model parity checked, coordinate-only protection must remain pending.

assertions: Exact status, expected criterion losses and full-credit invariants; no pass/fail inferred from filename.
